notes.title: Update Patch 1.0
notes.content:
[b][h2]Update Patch 1.0 is now available. Here are the details:[/h2][/b]

[u][b]Fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Cursor Glitch in Main Menu
[*] Cursor Toggle in Inventory
[/list]

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Improved AI Pathfinding (Navigation) on all maps
[*] Improved Random Loot Spawn in Horde Mode
[/list]

[u][b]Specific Changes[/b][/u]

[b]Non Police AI:[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased Health 
[*] Increased Max Damage
[*] Increased Wandering Radius
[/list]

[b]Police AI:[/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced Fire Rate
[*] Decreased Accuracy
[*] Increased Damage
[*] Increased Ammo Capacity
[*] Increased Wandering Radius
[/list]

[u][b]New[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Police Vehicles Now Have Emergency Lights On
[/list]

[u][b]Know bugs[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Some NPC's do not take damage when hit in some parts of a body
[/list]

[u][b]What's Next[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Address issues from above
[*] Urination System
[*] Create Pause System
[*] Improve Main Menu
[/list]

[i]PS: Urination System has been already added, but for some reason it doesn't work in game build. It definitely will by next Update Patch though. [/i]
